planning that looks ahead, a whole-centre summary, a CRM sidebar on the ticket, narrated lessons, security fixes, and the snag fixes already on staging.

Centre summary: Executive insights now has a whole-centre summary. It checks inbound, outbound, chat, email, tickets, people and quality against your targets, or industry norms where you haven't set any. It lists the top three things to fix, each with a plain step-by-step guide and a link to the right page, warns when figures are getting worse, sends one morning "Centre health" email when something new needs attention, and can be emailed weekly or monthly as a one-page PDF.

Workforce, Plan: forecasts use the method that predicted the recent past best, over any range of days. Edit the forecast in the grid (edited cells are marked, Undo takes the last change back), save versions as scenarios, compare them, and make one live. The forecast refreshes every night for the next 28 days.

Workforce, special days: mark public holidays and one-off days (a launch, a storm) with how much busier or quieter they are. The forecast uses them and leaves past holidays out of its history. The public holidays come from the opening-hours schedule you pick in Settings.

Workforce, Today: a projected end of day, projected service level per interval, and "What if more agents work", which shows what extra agents from a chosen time would change. Planned activities show in the day.

Workforce, shrinkage: set the share of time lost to each kind of time off per weekday in Settings, or learn it from history. Email and chat queues use their agents' real concurrency.

Workforce, backlog: email and ticket queues show the backlog over the coming days and the people needed to clear it in time.

Workforce, accuracy: a report of forecast against actual per interval, with accuracy and service level, filtered by queue and team.

CRM sidebar: a ticket app shows the customer's Salesforce, HubSpot or Dynamics record beside the ticket: owner, open deals and recent activity, with a link to the record. Agents see it with the same masking as the rest of the customer's details.

Narrated lessons: Academy lessons can be listened to in the organisation's voice. Very long lessons stay as text.

Surveys: NPS (0–10) and CES questions are scored from the caller's key presses.

Late-reply alerts: an alert that an email is waiting too long for a reply now waits until 08:00, like ticket alerts. Live chats still alert at once.

Snag fixes: the customer-waiting alert follows business hours; email From addresses are limited to the agent's queues; the whole email trail shows on the agent desk; a customer's interaction messages open from the 360 view; the Speechmatics connection; help curriculum fixes; the grouped flow step palette; admin page fixes.

Agent desk: an "allow pop-ups" bar while Available, and a warning when browser notifications are blocked.

AI receptionist: callers whose phones send no sound during silences are answered normally.

Untapped: malformed error details from Untapped are ignored instead of failing the call result.

Security: large uploads and reseller-move files are read only after sign-in is checked; web chat, CSP reports and transcript emails have per-address limits; two library advisories are fixed.
